pieces.Text: When you're fully photon-attuned, you can invite creatures of fiery power to fight for you as a standard action. This functions as summon creature (Alien Archive 144) with a spell level equal to one-third your solarian level. You select which four creatures you can summon each time you gain a solarian level, and they must all be fire creatures. The natural attacks of creatures you summon with this ability have the limning weapon fusion.
